revision: D045 development contract; not an implemented final-release claim
source_gaps: The exact distance/weights/tie rule and finite exhaustion budget are undisclosed.
The equity primary instrument replaces NQ and must be explicitly frozen.
The private dial grid and six named presets remain unknown.

implementation.isolation: Develop under data/dev025/src with synthetic-only stores. Keep the verified0.24 managed app available; integrate only after focused checks and managed idle shutdown. Do not copy credentials, prices, the main database or installed dependencies.
implementation.proposal_freeze: Generate and hash every bounded batch file and the complete plan manifest before any signal probe. Freeze master seed, canonical family/chart axes, per-family target, batch size, maximum batches per family, minimum signals, recipe and source identity. Preserve unused proposals and exhaustion; never silently extend the budget after observing prices.
implementation.draws: Use an explicit finite equities catalog. Draw charts/dials uniformly conditional on their prerequisites, with independent applicable filter groups including neutral values. Spread sampling is separate from common-random40/40/20 filter quotas. Preserve every drawn full configuration and stable per-slot stream key; classify duplicates explicitly.
implementation.balance: Use prior-centered squared-count discrepancy, separately for each public dial and its immediate prerequisite context. For a uniform k-value group with counts c and parent count n, score=(k*sum(c_i*c_i)-n*n)/(k-1)-n for k>1; fixed k=1 contributes zero. Sum equal-dial group scores. This is an explicitly disclosed metric choice, not the host private implementation. Subtracting n removes the random-draw variance contribution so enabling an extra dependent dial is not penalized solely for exposing another conditional group. Publish actual conditional counts/shares and zero-exposure groups separately; this score is not a p-value or proof of exhaustive coverage.
implementation.exact_selection: Rank unseen valid distinct batch proposals by exact integer score change, with proposal ordinal breaking exact ties. Probe in that order until the first at-least40-signal version; this is the minimum-score eligible member without probing worse-ranked versions unnecessarily. Retain failed probes, accepted choice and unprobed proposals. Failed qualification never uses profit, trade count or Sharpe. Already-probed configurations are not silently counted as new numerical attempts.
implementation.dependent_fields: Condition trigger on setup chart; confirmation domain on whether trigger is lower; confirmation window on non-none confirmation; expiry on limit entry; flat exit on intraday chart; gap stop on FVG; family dials on their supported families; sweep depth/reclaim on sweep family or enabled CHoCH sweep. Pullback min/max are drawn from explicit valid paired ranges and reported as both public fields. All Strategy fields must be fixed, drawn or explicitly inactive in the recipe.
implementation.evidence_and_recovery: A caller-provided durable event sink must commit probe_started before the signal callback and probe_completed before accepting a version. Replay a verified event prefix deterministically, reusing only completed matching probes under the same frozen context; authorization/cancellation/source checks precede new and reused probes. A journal mismatch fails before further numerical work. Save the complete selected configuration manifest and its hash only on full target completion, before any selected-account P&L evaluation. Partial exhaustion remains evidence and cannot queue a partial successful search.
implementation.primary_loading: The actual signal-probe service must load only the frozen primary instrument through a Parquet symbol predicate, with exact per-symbol guards/actions/session audits and an instrument-subset component in the prepared-cache key. Preserve all-source callers and full immutable parent-file integrity. An unrelated sealed instrument must remain unread/unviewed. Freeze calendar identity and complete calendar hash whenever news proposals are enabled; reject missing or ignored calendars before probes.
implementation.retry_identity: Persist probe_planned separately from each ordinal probe_started. An interrupted start without a committed result remains an interrupted attempt; a fresh ordinal must be persisted before recomputation. Completed matching probes may be reused. Reverify the entire frozen proposal plan before publishing any successful selected-set manifest; reopening requires its externally frozen plan identity.
implementation.integration_remaining: This contract first implements the proposal/balance/qualification core in the isolated source. Durable worker/trial registry/API/UI, full signal-artifact ownership, real-date protection, saved exports, actual source-scale resources and final conformance remain mandatory; pure callbacks or synthetic counts do not certify those integration requirements.
